fusions.name: Cut the Halyards
fusions.desc: A quick cut that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Lookout's Blade
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: throws a blade at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Muffled Oars
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, and you move 15% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Cutting-Out by Night
fusions.desc: At night, your damage rises by 10%, and your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
